title: Gero Performs Opening Theme for Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition TV Anime
content:
The anime will debut on January 4 on NHK General at 11:00 p.m. JST, and will have 12 episodes.

Returning cast members from the original Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun anime include:

• Ayumu Murase as Iruma

• Mitsuki Saiga as Opera

• Daisuke Ono as Naberius Callego

• Ryōhei Kimura as Asmodeus Alice

• Ayaka Asai as Valac Clara

• Saori Hayami as Amelie

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga and describes the story:

Get ready to meet the lovable cast of Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun as you've never seen them before! In this brand-new spinoff of the runaway hit series, Iruma is a dirt-poor but unfailingly cheerful young boy who grows up in a ruthless city slum. One day, Iruma gives an injured old man his last loaf of bread and nurses the stranger back to health—only to find out that the elder gent is none other than Don Sullivan, head of the Babyl Mafia! Soon after, Don Sullivan comes back, whisks Iruma away, and begs the boy to become his grandson. And just like that, Iruma begins his new life as the next in line to lead a gigantic gang of—dare we say—demonic mafiosos!

The spinoff manga launched in Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine in September 2023. The manga moved to Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in December 2025.

Nishi launched the Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun manga in Weekly Shōnen Champion in March 2017. The manga's first anime adaptation premiered in October 2019, and the second season premiered in April 2021, followed by the third season, which debuted in October 2022. The fourth anime season debuted on April 4.

title: Red Cat Ramen Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Main Promo Video, January 10 Debut
content:
The official website for the anime adaptation of ANGYAMAN 's Red Cat Ramen ( Ramen Akaneko ) manga revealed on Friday the second season will debut on January 10. The series will air on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on Sundays at 5:30 p.m. The anime will then debut on BS11 on January 11. The website also revealed the new season's main promotional video.

Rikon Densetsu performs the opening theme song "Kaette Oide" (Come Home) and Hana Hope performs the ending theme song "Akari."

Returning cast members include:

• Kenjirō Tsuda as Bunzō

• Noriaki Sugiyama as Sasaki

• Michiyo Murase as Sabu

• Rie Kugimiya as Hana

• Saori Hayami as Krishna

• Kurumi Orihara as Tamako Yashiro

Joining the cast is Tasuku Hatanaka as Jewel.

Hisatoshi Shimizu ( The Gymnastics Samurai , episode director for Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood ) is returning to direct the anime at E&H production , and E&H production and Good Smile Company are producing the anime. Shigeru Murakoshi is replacing Tōru Kubo to oversee and write the series scripts. Michinori Chiba ( Mobile Suit Gundam 00 , Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans ) is returning to design the characters and serve as chief animation director. Hirotaka Matsuoka is returning to compose the music.

Other staff members for the new season include:

• 3D Supervisor: Tomohiko Kan (returning)

• Art Directors: Yann Le Gall (returning), Julieta Colás (background art for season 1)

• Color Design: Chikako Kamata (returning)

• Director of Photography: Shinichi Igarashi (returning)

• Editing: Keisuke Yanagi (returning), ACE

• Sound Director: Akane Maeda (returning)

• Sound Effects: Maki Takuma (returning)

• Sound Production: Tôhoku Shinsha

The first season premiered in July 2024 on TBS and 28 other channels and had 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired.

The MANGA Plus service is serializing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Meet Tamako, who's found her way into an interview at a ramen shop run solely by cats. When the feline manager asks if she likes cats, Tamako admits that she's actually more of a dog person...only to be hired on the spot! But her job description isn't quite what she expects ? rather than serving ramen, she's now a dedicated cat caretaker...?!

ANGYAMAN first posted the manga on Shueisha 's Jump Rookie! site in November 2021, and Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service then picked up the manga for serialization in March 2022. It began its regular weekly serialization that October.
author: ANN

title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime's 2nd Season Reveals January Debut, More Cast in 1st Promo Video
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Amara 's The Cat and the Dragon ( Neko to Ryū ) novel series revealed on Friday the show's second season will debut in January 2027 and will air on Tokyo MX , BS NTV , YTV , and AT-X . The series will also stream on d Anime Store and ABEMA in Japan and will debut one week before the television debut.

The staff also revealed six new cast members for the new season (character name romanizations are not confirmed):

Additionally, Harutya will perform the opening theme song "Natsume." The above video previews the song.

The new season will feature a returning staff.

The anime stars:

• Takehito Koyasu as Nekoryū

• Kikuko Inoue as Mama-nyan

• Fūka Izumi as Shirotae

• Show Hayami as Kurobane

• Noriaki Sugiyama as Haibuchi

• Maki Kawase as Chiikuro

• Shinnosuke Tokudome as Kurotama

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Gally

• Chika Anzai as Anne Rossa

• Junya Enoki as Stan

• Yū Serizawa as Haneko

• Makoto Koichi as Prince

• Kazuya Ichijō as King

• Hinata Tadokoro as Greater Daemon

• Yōji Ueda as Monsha-Mosha IV

• Saho Shirasu as Mike-Mike

• Natsuki Hanae as Monaruka (Black)

• Tomohisa Asō as Pomupora

Jin-Koo Oh ( Tonbo! ) directed the first season at OLM . Mitsutaka Hirota ( Edens Zero ) handled the series scripts. Rie Nishino and Chiaki Kurakazu designed the characters. Takahiro Obata ( The Promised Neverland ) composed the music, and Noriyoshi Konuma ( The Dangers in My Heart ) was the sound director.

The first season streamed first on the d Anime Store and ABEMA services in Japan on June 27 at 9:30 p.m. (8:30 a.m. EDT), one week before its television broadcast and streaming on other services. The anime began airing on the Tokyo MX channel on July 4 at 9:00 p.m. JST, before running on BS NTV , Yomiuri TV , Nagasaki Culture Broadcasting, and AT-X .

In the story, deep in the forest, a fire breathing dragon lost its parents before it was born. By happenstance, a mother cat encounters the dragon and decides to raise it. The cat family welcomes the dragon, who is seen as a "slightly weird cat who can fly and breathe fire." The dragon, to repay the favor to the mother cat for raising it, decides to stay in the forest and watch over the other cats. The cats affectionally call the dragon "winged uncle," and the dragon is known among humankind as the "cat dragon."

Amara debuted the web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in September 2013. Takarajimasha began publishing the light novels in print with illustrations by Mai Ōkuma in April 2016.

Izumi Sasaki launched a manga adaptation on Kono Manga ga Sugoi! web in September 2017, and it also began serialization on Manga Box in April 2020.
author: ANN

title: Inherit the Winds TV Anime Reveals January 10 Debut in Video
content:
The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) revealed the show's January 10 debut in a main promotional video on Friday. The video also previews the anime's opening and ending theme songs.

The anime will debut on January 19 at 11:30 p.m. on the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks. The series will stream in Japan on services like U-NEXT and Anime Hōdai .

The anime takes place in the Bakumatsu era in Kyoto. A solider who has lost his memories is aided by the famous Shinsengumi member Okita Sōji. Okita Sōji names this man "Tachikawa Jinsuke." Jinsuke's life begins anew amidst the Mibu soldiers.

The anime will star ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ):

• Daisuke Sakuma (Snow Man member) as Tachikawa Jinsuke

• Yūki Kaji as Okita Sōji

• Aoi Yūki as Koganei Hyōgo

• Kōki Uchiyama as Hijikata Toshizō

• Yūichi Nakamura as Kondō Isami

• Nichika Ōmori as Kurosuke

• Ryōhei Kimura as Nagakura Shinpachi

• Ayumu Murase as Tōdō Heisuke

• Simba Tsuchiya as Harada Sanosuke

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Yamanaka Keisuke

• Yasuyuki Kase as Serizawa Kamo

• Takaya Kamikawa as Umeda Shinbei

• Daisuke Hirakawa as Niimi Nishiki

• Toshiyuki Toyonaga as Kawai Kisaburō

• Kappei Yamaguchi as Momoyama Kyūsai (name romanization not confirmed)

• Toshiki Kumagai as Yoshida Toshimaro

Yutaka Narui and Aniplex are in charge of the original story with cooperation by Azuki Mashiba . Tomohiro Kawamura is directing the anime at Live2D Creative Studio and Drive Inc. Narui is also writing the scripts. Fumi Ebina is the character designer, and Shigeru Kishida is composing the music.

Quruli and hitsujibungaku are performing the television anime's opening theme song "Kaze wo Tsugumono" (Inherit the Winds) and ending theme song "Namida no Kawa" (River of Tears). The latter is also the theatrical screening's theme song.

The anime's four-panel manga adaptation launches on Star Seas Company 's Twi4 (read as Tsuiyon) X (formerly Twitter ) account in 2026. Matsuri Muramatsu draws the manga.

Narui is writing a novel for the franchise that Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha, Ltd. will ship on December 24.

Narui is a playwright and founder of the theatrical troupe Caramel Box who has previously worked on many stage plays themed on the Shinsengumi. While one of the plays was also titled Kaze wo Tsugumono , the way the title is written is different (with "mono" being written in kanji for the play and in hiragana for the anime), and the anime is still listed as being an "original" TV anime.
author: ANN

title: 'Neko to Ryuu 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content:
• The official website for the Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) television anime revealed additional cast, opening theme song, and the first promotional video for the Season 2 on Friday. The second season adapting Amara 's fantasy light novel will premiere on Tokyo MX, BS NTV, AT-X, and Yomiuri TV in January 2027.

Cast Kururuka: Emiri Iwai ( Ghost Concert: Missing Songs ) Crow: Satoshi Hino ( Champignon no Majo ) Yajurou: Katsuyuki Konishi ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) Boy: Megumi Han ( Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ) Hakka: Ayaka Asai ( Himekishi wa Barbaroi no Yome ) Marcotte: Kakeru Hatano ( Arne no Jikenbo )

Japanese singer Harutya ( Zatsu Tabi ) is performing the opening theme "Natsume," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

Jin-Gu Oh ( Ooi! Tonbo ) is returning to direct the anime at OLM . Mitsutaka Hirota ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) is handling the series composition. Chiaki Kurakazu ( Pokemon (2023) animation director) and Rie Nishino ( Nanatsu no Taizai: Kamigami no Gekirin ) are designing the characters, while Takahiro Obata ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) is composing the music.

Amara began serializing the fantasy light novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in September 2013. Takarajimasha began publishing the light novel in April 2016, with illustrations by Mai Okuma . The tenth volume was released on August 26.

A manga adaptation by Izumi Sasaki began serializing on the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! Web in September 2017. The 13th volume was released on July 24.

title: Odekake Kozame Gets 1st Stop-Motion Short
content:
Kadokawa unveiled the first stop-motion short for Penguin Box 's Odekake Kozame ( Little Shark's Day Out ) manga on Friday. The short, titled "Doughnut," shows Kozame-chan finding a doughnut on top of a table.

The manga and its anime adaptations follow the nostalgic everyday adventures of a young shark.

Penguin Box debuted the manga on X (formerly Twitter ) in June 2021. The manga's eighth compiled book volume shipped in Japan on March 16.

The manga's first anime adaptation premiered on YouTube in August 2023, and its 60th and final episode streamed in May 2024. The anime also aired on television.

The first film, Eiga Odekake Kozame Tokai no Otomodachi , opened in Japan in August 2025. The film centers on the titular character Kozame-chan's trip to the city, when she sees a glittering poster of the city in front of the Yaocho's train station. Dazed by a shark-shaped cloud, Kozame-chan boards the train and heads to the bright, noisy, crowded city, and starts a big adventure.

The second, ongoing season premiered on April 12 on TV Tokyo and its affiliates inside the Animori! program, which airs at 7:00 a.m. JST. The season also began streaming on YouTube on April 12 at 7:05 a.m. JST.

The franchise will have a second anime film titled Eiga Odekake Kozame Mizu no Machi no Omoide ( Little Shark's Day Out the Movie: Memories of the Water Town). The movie shares a title with the franchise's first volume-long manga story, which shipped on November 19.
author: ANN

title: Monogatari Off & Monster Season Anime's New Episode Airs on December 31
content:
Aniplex announced on Friday the " Wazamonogatari : Karen Ogre" episode of the MONOGATARI Series: OFF & MONSTER Season anime will air on December 31. The staff also revealed a new key visual and a promotional video.

Mulasaki Ima performs the episode's theme song "Shelter." The above video previews the song.

The special will air on December 31 at 9:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV . The special stars Eri Kitamura as Karen Araragi.

Franchise veteran Akiyuki Simbo is again serving as chief director and Midori Yoshizawa is directing the new episode at SHAFT . Fuyashi Tou returns to oversee the series scripts with Simbo, and Akio Watanabe is also back as character designer and chief animation director.

The anime began streaming exclusively on the ABEMA service in Japan in July 2024. The anime's 14th episode streamed in October 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it was released in Japan.

NisiOisin 's novel series began with the two-volume Bakemonogatari story in 2006, and it served as the basis for the first anime adaptation of the novels in 2009. The novel series' "final season" ended with Zoku Owarimonogatari in September 2014, but it featured a teaser for " Monogatari Series, Next Season Tsugimonogatari ." Tsugimonogatari is the latest novel in the series, and it shipped in October 2025.

Four "Off Season" volumes — Orokamonogatari , Wazamonogatari , Nademonogatari , and Musubimonogatari — shipped in October 2015, January 2016, July 2016, and January 2017, respectively. The volumes tell a series of short stories set at different points throughout the series.

The novel series' "Monster Season" launched with the Shinobumonogatari novel in July 2017. Other novels in the season include Yoimonogatari , Amarimonogatari , Ōgimonogatari , and the two-volume Shinomonogatari novel, which shipped in August 2021. The novels tell a continuation of the franchise, taking place in college.

The anime began streaming exclusively on the ABEMA service in Japan in July 2024. The anime's 14th episode streamed in October 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it was released in Japan.

NisiOisin 's novel series began with the two-volume Bakemonogatari story in 2006, and it served as the basis for the first anime adaptation of the novels in 2009. The novel series' "final season" ended with Zoku Owarimonogatari in September 2014, but it featured a teaser for " Monogatari Series, Next Season Tsugimonogatari ." Tsugimonogatari is the latest novel in the series, and it shipped in October 2025.

Four "Off Season" volumes — Orokamonogatari , Wazamonogatari , Nademonogatari , and Musubimonogatari — shipped in October 2015, January 2016, July 2016, and January 2017, respectively. The volumes tell a series of short stories set at different points throughout the series.

The novel series' "Monster Season" launched with the Shinobumonogatari novel in July 2017. Other novels in the season include Yoimonogatari , Amarimonogatari , Ōgimonogatari , and the two-volume Shinomonogatari novel, which shipped in August 2021. The novels tell a continuation of the franchise, taking place in college.

title: Solitary Gourmet Live-Action Series Gets 10th Straight New Year's Eve Special
content:
TV Tokyo announced on Thursday that the live-action series of Masayuki Kusumi and Jiro Taniguchi 's Kodoku no Gourmet ( Solitary Gourmet ) manga will have its 10th consecutive New Year's special, tentatively titled Kodoku no Gourmet 2026 Ōmisoka Special . The special will air on December 31 starting at 10:00 p.m. JST.

The special will again star Yutaka Matsushige as Gorō Inagashira, and will center on Gorō leaving Saga and going to Thailand, a location that is a first for the franchise .

Both the live-action Solitary Gourmet series and the original manga follow a solitary salesman named Gorō Inagashira as he travels all over Japan and samples the local cuisine found on street corners. The live-action show's 11th season debuted on April 3.

The franchise also had a six-episode live-action mini-series project titled Kodoku no Gourmet ~Oishii kedo Horo Nigai... Inagashira Gorō no Sainan~ (Solitary Gourmet ~It's Tasty But Slightly Bitter... Gorō Inagashira's Misfortune~) that debuted on the Paravi and Hikari TV streaming services in March to April 2022.

Masayuki Kusumi and Jiro Taniguchi first serialized the Kodoku no Gourmet manga from 1994 to 1996 in Fusosha 's Monthly Panja magazine (now defunct). Kusumi handled the story, and Taniguchi drew the art. Fusosha published the first collected volume in 1997. Kusumi and Fusosha published the manga's second volume in September 2015. Taniguchi died in February 2017.

The manga also inspired a net anime that debuted on Production I.G 's "Tate Anime" (Vertical Anime) smartphone app in November 2017.

Fanfare and Ponent Mon released the manga in English in the U.S. in October 2025. Turnaround Publisher Services in the U.K. released the manga in July 2025.

title: Additional Cast for 'Shuiro no Kamen' Announced
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's Shuiro no Kamen ( The Vermilion Mask ) manga announced five additional cast members on Friday. The anime series began airing on October 10 at 5:30 p.m. on Yomiuri TV and Nippon TV, with the second part will air in April 2027.

Cast Kaku: Kazuyuki Okitsu ( The Fable ) Suzume: Yuu Hayashi ( Tokyo Revengers ) Biran: Katsuyuki Konishi ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) Liberal: Yukana ( Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch ) Zeguma: Tomokazu Sugita ( Gintama )

Tetsuaki Watanabe ( Blue Lock ) is directing the series at 100studio , with Daisuke Oohigashi ( Noblesse script) handling the series composition. Hisashi Higashijima ( Mashle ) is designing the characters. Alisa Okehazama ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) is composing the music.

Dr.Poro and Naba began serializing the action fantasy manga in Young King OURs magazine in February 2021. Shounen Gahousha published the ninth volume on July 6, with the tenth volume scheduled for a November 30 release.

emaqi publishes the manga digitally in English in September 2024.
